title: The Great Wall of China
examples: Which dynasty built the most visible parts of the Great Wall?
What was the main reason the Chinese built this massive wall?
How long is the entire Great Wall system today?

explain.say: The Great Wall was not built by just one group of rulers. Different dynasties built parts over many years.

items: Ming Dynasty: Most visible sections built

explain.say: Now let me show you the real thing in 3D: the Great Wall of China. Look at the wall, the watchtower and the battlements. Tap any part, and I will tell you what it does.
The Ming Wall is the most famous section we see today. It was built by the Ming Dynasty rulers.
The main purpose was defense. It helped protect Chinese states from invaders coming from the north.
The total length is enormous. It covers thousands of miles across different terrains.
In real life, thinking about this wall reminds us of massive human effort. Building something so huge takes many generations.

items: Step 3: Completion of a massive structure

explain.say: A common mistake is thinking one person built it all. Remember, many different dynasties added sections over hundreds of years.

faq.q: Why did the Chinese build such a long wall?
faq.a: The primary reason was to defend their settled agricultural lands from nomadic groups coming from the north. It was a massive border defense system.
asks: Was it just a border marker?

faq.q: Which dynasty built the wall we see the most?
faq.a: The Ming Dynasty built many of the sections that are most famous and visible today. They reinforced and rebuilt older parts.
asks: Is the Ming Wall the only part?
Which dynasty's work is most visible?

faq.q: How long is the entire structure?
faq.a: The total length is measured in thousands of miles, covering many different sections built over time. It is an immense scale of construction.

faq.q: Did the wall stop invaders completely?
faq.a: While it was a huge military undertaking, it was not an impenetrable barrier. It was part of a larger defensive strategy.

faq.q: What does 'dynasty' mean in this context?
faq.a: A dynasty refers to a succession of rulers from the same family or ruling group over a long period. China had many ruling dynasties.
asks: Does it mean a family line of rulers?

facts: The Great Wall system was built and rebuilt by various dynasties over centuries.
The Ming Dynasty significantly reinforced and built many of the well-preserved sections.
Its purpose was primarily military defense against northern nomadic groups.
The total length spans thousands of miles across different geographical areas.

quiz.say: Which dynasty built the most recognizable and visible sections of the Great Wall?
quiz.why: The Ming Dynasty rulers undertook major construction and reinforcement of the wall we see today.

wrong.1: This dynasty built very early sections, but the visible parts are mostly from later periods.
wrong.2: The Han Dynasty also built major sections, but the Ming work is more recognizable.
wrong.3: The Tang Dynasty is known for other achievements, not the main wall construction.

quiz.say: What was the main strategic purpose of building the Great Wall?

options.show: To mark the edge of the known world.
options.say: To mark the edge of the known world.

options.show: To keep people inside the empire.
options.say: To keep people inside the empire.

options.show: To defend settled lands from northern invaders.
options.say: To defend settled lands from northern invaders.

quiz.why: The wall served as a massive military fortification protecting settled Chinese civilization.

wrong.0: It was a military border, not just a geographical boundary marker.
wrong.1: Its function was defense against outside groups, not internal control.
wrong.3: While it influenced trade, its primary role was military defense, not just commerce.

quiz.say: The Great Wall's total length demonstrates what kind of human achievement?

options.show: Immense scale of human effort over time.
options.say: Immense scale of human effort over time.

quiz.why: The sheer length and the fact that multiple dynasties contributed show massive, sustained effort.

wrong.1: It required centuries of work from many different ruling groups.
wrong.2: It was a complex, fortified military system, not just a line on the ground.
wrong.3: It is a system of walls, trenches, and natural barriers, not one unbroken line.
